Package sc.fiji.snt.util

Class IOUtils

java.lang.Object
sc.fiji.snt.util.IOUtils
public final class IOUtils extends Object
Static utilities for file I/O, namely the detection of reconstruction file formats.

    detectFormat(InputStream is, boolean closeStreamAfterGuess)
    Guesses the format of a reconstruction file from its first bytes (not its extension): gzip magic number, XML (Neurolucida if the header holds an <mbf> root element), JSON (invalid input: '{@code '{'}), NDF ({@code '/'}), or SWC otherwise. @param is the stream to be inspected.       Guesses the format of a reconstruction file from its first bytes (not its extension): gzip magic number, XML (Neurolucida if the header holds an <mbf> root element), JSON (invalid input: '{@code '{'}), NDF ({@code '/'}), or SWC otherwise. @param is the stream to be inspected. If it supports marking, it is reset after inspection (unless {@code closeStreamAfterGuess} is true) @param closeStreamAfterGuess whether {@code is} should be closed after inspection @return the detected format @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs'

    • getReconstructionExtensions

      public static String[] getReconstructionExtensions()
      Returns the extensions (lower case, without the leading period) of the supported reconstruction formats that can be identified by name alone, i.e., not including Neurolucida .xml files
      Returns:
      a new array of extensions, e.g., "swc", "traces", etc.

    • isSWCFile

      public static boolean isSWCFile(File file)
      Checks if a file has an SWC extension, i.e., .swc or .eswc (extended SWC, which holds extra columns that are ignored on import). Case-insensitive.
      Parameters:
      file - the file to be tested
      Returns:
      true if the file name ends with ".swc" or ".eswc"

    • isReconstructionFile

      public static boolean isReconstructionFile(File file)
      Checks if a file is a reconstruction file based on its extension only (SWC, TRACES, JSON or NDF). Neurolucida XML files are not recognized by this method, see isReconstructionFile(File, boolean)
      Parameters:
      file - the file to be tested
      Returns:
      true if the extension is that of a supported reconstruction format

    • isReconstructionFile

      public static boolean isReconstructionFile(File file, boolean sniffXml)
      Checks if a file is a reconstruction file. Apart from the extension-only check, XML files are recognized as Neurolucida reconstructions if sniffXml is true and their header is that of a Neurolucida file. Only the first few KB of XML files are read.
      Parameters:
      file - the file to be tested
      sniffXml - whether .xml files should be inspected
      Returns:
      true if the file is a supported reconstruction file
